title: LeafiumBoost
description: 🍃 LeafiumBoost is a lightweight, high-performance Minecraft Fabric modpack designed to maximize FPS, reduce lag, optimize resource usage, improve loading times, and deliver a smoother, faster, and more stable gameplay experience.
body:
## ・🍃 LeafiumBoost Details :
LeafiumBoost is a carefully curated Fabric optimization modpack focused on delivering maximum performance, improved stability, and a seamless vanilla Minecraft experience. Every included mod has been selected to increase FPS, reduce lag, optimize resource usage, and enhance overall gameplay without adding unnecessary content.

Whether you're playing on a low-end laptop or a high-end gaming PC, LeafiumBoost helps Minecraft run smoother, load faster, and remain more responsive across both singleplayer and multiplayer.

## ・💡 Why LeafiumBoost?
Unlike large modpacks that include unnecessary content, LeafiumBoost focuses exclusively on performance, optimization, and stability. Every included mod serves a purpose—eliminating bottlenecks, improving rendering, reducing resource usage, and delivering a smoother gameplay experience.

The result is a lightweight, efficient, and highly compatible modpack that helps Minecraft run at its best on virtually any system.
Boost your FPS. Reduce lag. Load worlds faster. Experience Minecraft the way it was meant to run—with LeafiumBoost. 🍃
